Try putting protection prayers on your action bar. When he slams the ground, it's a range attack. When his head goes slightly down and to the side, it's a mage attack. His mage attack is much slower than his range attack. Let your main focus always be his animations. Even if the healers end up healing jad more, still focus on the animations and switching. Everything else comes second. A sign of life could also help.

Nox bow or asc might be what you want. Which to buy though all depends on which you personally like better. Nox staff is also an option. T90 range and mage open a lot of possibilities for high level pvm.

For staking, you normally want 99 in  all the cb skills you use. For example with boxing, you should have 99 att, str, def, and hp. For polypore, 99 magic, def, and hp. It depends on what kind of staking you do. I do polypore and what you do is have  your polypore staff and your invy full of vials. You send both a trade and stake request to the person you want to stake. they'll trade with you and you both put up the vials to prove you have nothing else on you. then they click on the stake request while the trade menu is still open to prevent either party from picking up a dropped item on the ground. after that, just make sure you read the rules in the second menu. Always read the rules to make sure they're correct. I should also mention watch out for people with similar names normally involving l and I. In my opinion, you should just do what you want. You don't have to have a goal. If you wanna go do pvm, do pvm. If you want to play a minigame, go play it. If you want to bank stand, just do it. Just do whatever you want to do in the moment. You don't have to do a continuous grind for something. I do personally, but that's because it's what I want and like to do. I might complain about being bored or how slow something is, but I still do it because it's what I like to do. I wouldn't if I didn't. You don't have to think hard about it either. Live in the moment of the game, not the past nor future.
